entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Finally, a person! I bought a jersey from you people and it's completely the wrong size. This is unacceptable!
I'm sorry to hear that you're having an issue with the fit. I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?

Yes, it's VF56-2291. And I don't want to just talk about it, I want it fixed. This jersey is way too tight. I need to get an exchange or my money back right now, or I'm lighting you up on every review site on the internet. This is ridiculous.
I understand your frustration, and I assure you I'll do everything I can to resolve this for you. Let me just pull up that order... VF56-2291. One moment.
Don't put me on hold. I've been waiting long enough. Is your service always this slow? Maybe I should just talk to your manager.
There's no need for that, sir. I can handle this. I see your order for the Pro-Series Jersey was delivered 39 days ago. The good news is that you are well within our 90-day return policy.
Oh. So you can help me then?
Absolutely. I can process a return for a full refund or an exchange for a different size immediately. Since you mentioned the jersey was too tight, would you like to exchange it for the next size up?
Yes. An exchange would be great. I need a Large.

Perfect. I've just initiated that exchange for you. I am sending a prepaid return label to the email we have on file. Just use that to send back the original jersey, and we'll get the new one shipped out to you right away.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
